name: AI Chat
description: An AI prompt composer built around a light input card floating over an inverse-shell control row. The mode and model pickers morph from pill to panel via shared layoutId springs, the plus button fans a radial attachment menu, the tool chips stagger in with a cross-blur, and the mic swaps to a live waveform while a typewriter transcript slides in above. Every list — attachments, tools, modes, models, transcript phrases — is a prop, selection is controlled or uncontrolled per dimension, and the whole surface is driven by globals.css theme tokens so it flips cleanly between light and dark.

variations.name: default
variations.previewHint: Open the plus (radial attachments), the sparkle (tool chips), and the mode/model pills (morphing panels), then tap the mic to watch it swap to a waveform with a typewriter transcript
variations.description: A theme-token-driven AI prompt composer. Mode and model pickers morph between a collapsed pill and an expanded panel through a shared layoutId spring with a blur cross-fade; the plus button fans out a radial attachment menu; tool chips reveal with a staggered cross-blur; the mic cross-fades to an animated waveform while a typewriter transcript slides in. Attachments, tools, modes, models, and transcript phrases are all props, with controlled/uncontrolled selection per dimension.

props.name: heading
props.description: Headline above the composer. Dims to 0.35 opacity while recording.

props.name: placeholder
props.default: "Our AI is ready to help. Ask it anything..."
props.description: Placeholder text for the prompt input.

props.name: arcItems
props.description: Radial menu items fanned out by the plus button. Each: { icon, label, angle? }. Omit angle and items auto-distribute across a 110° arc; provide it to pin a fixed angle.

props.name: toolItems
props.default: built-in 4 (Create image, Thinking, Deep research, Web search)
props.description: Tool chips revealed by the sparkle button. Each: { icon, label }. The selected tool's icon replaces the sparkle glyph.

props.name: modes
props.description: Mode picker options. Each: { id, label, icon, desc }. Rendered as the left morphing pill/panel.

props.name: models
props.description: Model picker options. Each: { id, label, tier, color }. color paints the round monogram badge; the list scrolls past six entries.

props.name: mockPhrases
props.description: Phrase pool the mock voice recording types out. A random entry is chosen each time recording starts.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled input value. When set, the composer input is controlled — pair with onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial input value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires on every input change, and when an accepted transcript is pushed into the field.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Fires when Enter is pressed (without Shift) in the input.

props.name: defaultModeId
props.description: Uncontrolled initial mode selection, by id.

props.name: modeId
props.description: Controlled mode selection, by id. When set, the mode dimension is controlled.

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Fires with the full option after a mode is picked.

props.name: defaultModelId
props.description: Uncontrolled initial model selection, by id.

props.name: modelId
props.description: Controlled model selection, by id. When set, the model dimension is controlled.

props.name: onModelChange
props.description: Fires with the full option after a model is picked.

props.name: onToolChange
props.description: Fires when a tool chip is toggled — the option when selected, null when the same chip is deselected.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Fires when a radial attachment item is clicked.

props.name: onRecordingChange
props.description: Fires when the mic toggles the recording state on or off.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged onto the composer's max-width wrapper.

features: Morphs the mode and model pickers between a collapsed pill and an expanded panel via a shared layoutId, springing size, position, and border-radius in one motion while the inner content cross-fades through a blur
Fans the plus button's attachment items out along an arc from per-item sin/cos offsets, rotating the trigger 45° and staggering each item on a stiffness/damping spring

Reveals tool chips with a reverse-stagger panel drop — y-translate plus a 2px cross-blur on the transitions-dev ease — and swaps the sparkle glyph for the selected tool's icon through an AnimatePresence popLayout cross-fade
Cross-fades the mic into a looping height-keyframe waveform and slides a typewriter transcript panel in above the input, dimming the heading, input, and controls to 0.35 while recording

Uses an inverse bg-foreground/text-background shell for pills, chips, panels, and transcript so the two-tone contrast survives both themes; disables the input during recording and collapses every transition under prefers-reduced-motion

featureSections.title: Morphing Mode & Model Pickers
featureSections.summary: Bridges a collapsed pill and an expanded panel with a shared layoutId so the shell reads as one object growing, driven by which menu is open.
points: Interpolates size, position, and border-radius across a single layoutId, keeping those values inline so the layout spring can animate them
Runs an asymmetric Apple-style spring — expand with slight bounce, collapse snappier with none
Cross-fades panel content separately with opacity, a 4px blur, and a 0.97 scale, exiting faster than it enters
Swaps pill and panel through AnimatePresence in popLayout so the outgoing shell leaves flow immediately
Selects mode and model per id as controlled or uncontrolled, reporting the full option via onModeChange / onModelChange

featureSections.title: Radial Attachment Menu
featureSections.summary: Fans the plus button's items out along an arc using per-item trigonometric offsets and a staggered spring.
points: Positions each item from sin/cos of its angle at a fixed radius, auto-distributing across 110° when no angle is given
Rotates the plus trigger 45° into a close affordance on an ease-out tween
Springs items out with stiffness/damping and a small per-item open delay, adding a blur-in on entry
Collapses on item click or an outside-click catcher, firing onAttach with the chosen item

featureSections.title: Tool Chips & Icon Swap
featureSections.summary: Drops tool chips in with a reverse-staggered panel reveal and swaps the trigger glyph for the active tool.
points: Translates chips from a -130% y-offset with a 2px cross-blur on the transitions-dev ease
Reverses the stagger order on open and runs the close faster than the open
Cross-fades the sparkle icon to the selected tool's icon via AnimatePresence popLayout with a scale-and-blur
Toggles selection off when the same chip is tapped, tinting the trigger with the rose accent while active

featureSections.title: Voice Recording & Transcript
featureSections.summary: Cross-fades the mic to a live waveform and types a transcript into a panel that slides in above the composer.
points: Swaps the mic for a waveform of bars looping independent height keyframes at staggered delays
Slides the transcript panel down from a -110% offset on an ease-out-quart, revealing a blinking caret
Types the phrase character by character on an interval, then pushes it into the input when accepted
Dims the heading, input, and control row to 0.35 and disables the input for the duration of recording
